The exception is a runtime exception, signaling a programming error or precondition failure. The method is private, meaning it is called only within the same class, so the caller should ensure that the parameter exists before invoking this method. The throw is intended to alert the developer to a bug, not to be caught and handled in normal flow. Thus, the programmer likely expects the exception to propagate and not be catched externally.
